    setArm(armL, elArmLU, elArmLF, elHandL, elFingL, elArmL);
    setArm(armR, elArmRU, elArmRF, elHandR, elFingR, elArmR);
  }

  window.nwb = { render: render };
  render(0);
})();
</script>
